title: Single-Lane Zero-Coordination Fast Path and Telemetry Budget
owner_directive: Run one final operations pass before GPR continues: when only one lane is active, remove concurrent-writer/READY-queue/rebase work from the ordinary path; further streamline execution; and prevent recurring over-instrumentation abuse.
external_patterns_reviewed: GitHub protected branches: merge queues are particularly useful for busy branches receiving many pull requests from many users, and are not a universal requirement.
GitHub status-check strictness: requiring an up-to-date branch can cause additional builds; loose checks use fewer builds, while merge queues provide fresh-base safety for busy branches.
GitHub pull-request merge methods: rebase is an optional history strategy and can increase repeated conflict resolution.

OpenTelemetry sampling guidance: instrumentation has direct compute cost, engineering-maintenance cost and opportunity cost, supporting an explicit telemetry budget rather than recording every observation.
design_decisions: Derive single-active-lane mode once from fresh CURRENT and do not repeatedly scan terminal sibling lanes.
Exactly one nonterminal persistent lane bypasses the READY queue entirely; two or more retain FIFO READY coordination.
Single-lane protected-main mutation remains PR-only, exact-head and fresh-base, with expected-head merge protection.

Routine rebasing or update-branch work is prohibited. Actual main drift reruns only the narrow integration gate; a real conflict or repair may change the candidate head and then requires exact-head revalidation.
Owner re-entry remains checkpoint-local diagnostic input for stall detection but no longer creates a lane-state revision or interaction-count receipt.
Lane-state remains milestone-only: started, prequeue_green, published, then one successor reseed.
Lane scans, sibling scans, queue-empty checks, owner re-entry, rebase checks and mergeability polling are explicitly instrumentation-only and cannot be recorded as material progress.
The existing dependency-scoped heavy content validation from OPS3-12 is retained.

branch_protection_observation.connection_result: The connected GitHub App could not read branch-protection endpoints (403 administration permission required). Repository ruleset reads returned no rulesets, which is not evidence that legacy branch protection is absent.
branch_protection_observation.disposition: Fail closed: preserve PR-only protected-main mutation, exact-head validation, one fresh-main integration binding and expected-head merge protection.

validation_rule: Completion is valid only when the exact candidate head passes the required PR workflow and the durable protected-main merge is verified. Do not create another control-plane commit merely to copy workflow IDs or merge observations into this record.
next_action: Resume GPR-10. While it remains the only nonterminal persistent lane, use the OPS3-13 single-lane zero-coordination fast path.
